mainEntity.name: What information is needed to frame a structural wall correctly?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process usually starts with measuring the space, confirming which walls are load-bearing, and identifying openings, beams, and required bracing. From there, the framing plan should show stud size and spacing, headers, king studs, trimmers, sheathing, and any needed calculations for non-prescriptive bracing.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need the wall layout, load conditions, opening sizes, stud and header details, and any required bracing or engineering notes. Without those details, the framing can be wrong or unsafe.
